evidence.description: Six gene categories, two side-by-side open bars per gene. A narrow visible gap separates the two bars; tall red Elovl3 side outlines continue across the physical axis gap.
Round filled points, matching group colors, overlay the bars with small horizontal offsets; some points overlap.

Shared categorical x axis and two visibly separated linear numeric y-axis segments. Printed lower ticks 0, 5, 10, 15; upper ticks 40, 50, 60, 70, 80. Upper pixels per unit are about one third lower; spine ends use horizontal terminal strokes.
Extrapolated upper lower bound is near 35 and lower segment ends near 15.
